title: Nested RLS chain: attachments -> comments -> documents -> memberships
issue: A policy that reads a table which has its own RLS expands the inner policies too: SubPlan inside SubPlan, one layer per level, none pulled up.
symptom: naive_rls child-table counts are far slower than the parent and get worse with depth (attachments, level 3, worst). best_practice_rls (SECURITY DEFINER arrays) is flat but materialises big id arrays.

scale.meaning: rows in app.documents, app.comments and app.attachments (1:1:1 chain, 100 docs per org, scale/20 users).
